method: Ordinary pictures and standard PMTiles/Mapzen; no bespoke surveys or new terrain providers.

pictures.author: Diego Delso
pictures.observed: Whole elevation and magnified three small south approach openings, lower water arch and separate arch above it. Two dominant arches and a small north opening form the remaining crossing.

pictures.author: Diego Delso
pictures.observed: Second whole oblique view confirms the double-crested parapet/profile and asymmetric openings. This is an exterior photo, not a deck/underside survey.

pictures.author: Diego Delso
pictures.observed: Closer same-face view confirms masonry arch rims, raised parapets and rectangular projecting pier faces. Opposite-face details remain inferred.

mapSurface: Exact mapped bridge tags specify unhewn_cobblestone. The draft paving uses the existing low-frequency irregular stone graph; exact individual cobbles are not reconstructed.
